content:
Last month, OpenAI teased hardware products under the Codex brand. The company today officially launched its collaboration with Work Louder: the Codex Micro keyboard, priced at US$230.

Here is the product introduction:

The product comes in two versions: a tactile version with blue switches and a silent version.

The official website states: "Every Agent key lights up with RGB effects based on Codex's real-time status, so you can tell at a glance whether it is thinking, executing, waiting, or finished — without having to switch conversations."

The product page also lists three Codex-exclusive features:

  • Instant skill triggers: flick the joystick to launch common Codex workflows, such as reviewing a pull request, fixing bugs, or refactoring code.
  • Core operations at your fingertips: dedicated shortcut keys for the most frequently used commands, including accept, reject, conversation keys, new chat, and more. Less switching, faster delivery.
  • Freely tune compute power: turn the knob to adjust inference intensity on the fly. Stay fast on simple tasks, and ramp up the horsepower when work calls for deeper thinking.
